brussels-ardennes-semois-sweep.title: Brussels · Ardennes Semois Sweep
brussels-ardennes-semois-sweep.slogan: A 317 km loop out of Dinant river
brussels-ardennes-semois-sweep.story: River bends, forest roads and a proper Belgian escape. A 317 km loop that starts and ends near Dinant, about 5 h 28 of riding. It goes by way of Bouillon castle bend, Semois valley roads and Namur. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows.

scenicChapters.title: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10 → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 39 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fort-site-and-civil-settlement-of.story: From Neustadt an der Donau it runs 186 km to Neustadt an der Donau; allow about 3 h 12 of riding. The stops in between: Watchtowers WP 15/8 to 15/10, Fort site of Burgsalach, fort site and civil settlement of Theilenh and back through Fort site of Burgsalach. The line favours views over speed.
